question: Can a gate that compares each observation with already-labelled observations reuse labels with zero wrong picks and at least 29 correct on the 140 test cases?
decision: Whether the neighbour check becomes the candidate mechanism for first label reuse, and what Experiment 13 must beat.

H1.statement: The nested-fold neighbour gate passes Tier 1: W == 0 and C >= 29 over the 140 pooled held-out decisions.

decision_rule.pass: H1 holds: candidate mechanism; Tier 2 needs fresh labelled data; Experiment 13 tests whether Clef adds correct matches.
decision_rule.inconclusive: H1 fails with W == 0 and a rising learning curve: safe but starved; grow the reviewed set.
decision_rule.fail: H1 fails with W > 0: the neighbour check alone is unsafe; Experiment 13 decides whether an agreement gate fixes it.

stats.test: Tier 1 rule on pooled held-out decisions; no significance test
stats.interval: exact one-sided 95% binomial upper bound on W/E

ruler: Experiment 11 plan.json key ruler; Tier 1 W == 0 and C >= 29; acceptable-label sets from Experiment 11 output/build.json

gates.G1_integrity: every pinned hash verifies before and after; vector records match their pinned file
gates.G2_completeness: every test case gets exactly one held-out decision: accept a label, or park
gates.G3_fold_hygiene: no case or same-group case is in its own gallery or inner selection; an injected leak is refused

reported_not_gated.review_load: parked count and holding-pen groups; not gated by user decision on 2026-10-11
reported_not_gated.paired_vs_experiment06: Experiment 06 wrong picks on none_fit cases that the gate parks; Experiment 06 correct picks that the gate keeps
reported_not_gated.exploratory_grid: every grid rule applied directly to the 140 cases; exploratory because it looks at test cases

embedding.source: Experiment 01 cached vectors; no new calls

gate.accept: all k nearest same-section gallery members carry X, X is not none_fit, nearest similarity >= tau, nearest X minus nearest non-X (none_fit included) >= delta
gate.gallery_labels: existing labels and none_fit members both kept

folds.assignment: sort the 125 test groups by SHA-256 of the group name; deal round-robin into 5 folds
folds.outer_gallery: 60 development cases plus test cases outside the fold
folds.inner_selection: leave-one-out inside the outer gallery, excluding the query's own group
folds.choose: zero inner wrong accepts, most inner correct accepts; ties to larger tau then larger delta; none qualifies means the fold accepts nothing

learning_curve.rising: mean C at 1.0 >= mean C at 0.5 + 5, with W == 0 at both

outputs_for_experiment13: output/predictions.json (decision and 10 nearest same-section gallery members per test case)
